definitions.gloss: plain; easy; simple; easy to understand
definitions.explanation: Describes language, writing, or explanations that are clear and simple, avoiding difficult or technical expressions. Often used to praise clear writing or speaking.

examples.japanese: {平易|へいい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平易|へいい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: This book is written in plain, easy-to-understand prose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門的|せんもんてき}→専門的：15633_senmonteki⟧な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平易|へいい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解説|かいせつ}する→解説する：17850_kaisetsusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Explaining technical content in plain terms is actually very difficult.

notes:
USAGE:
A na-adjective from {平|へい} (flat, even) + {易|い} (easy). Primarily used to describe language, text, or explanations — not physical tasks. Functions as a modifier with な ({平易|へいい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧) or adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({平易|へいい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平易|へいい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (plain language)
- {平易|へいい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧ (plain writing)
- {平易|へいい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧ (to explain in simple terms)
- {平易|へいい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write in plain style)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: simple, easy — broader in use, not limited to language
- ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい: easy to understand — more colloquial
- ⟦{平明|へいめい}→平明：21801_heimei⟧: clear and simple — a near synonym, slightly more literary
